description.fr-FR: Traité de logique composé pour l’éducation du Dauphin, en trois livres selon les trois opérations de l’esprit : concevoir, juger, raisonner. Écrit vers 1677-1678, publié en 1828. Édition Lachat (1864).
description.en-US: A treatise on logic composed for the education of the Dauphin, in three books following the three operations of the mind: conceiving, judging, reasoning. Written around 1677-78 and published in 1828. Lachat edition (1864).
description.pt-BR: Tratado de lógica composto para a educação do Delfim, em três livros segundo as três operações do espírito: conceber, julgar, raciocinar. Escrito por volta de 1677-1678 e publicado em 1828. Edição Lachat (1864).

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume XXIII, pages 008-010. The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.
